column2: 中古英语 taske（差事、赋税）← 诺曼法语 tasque ← 中世纪拉丁语 tasca，为 taxa 的变体 ← 拉丁语 taxō（估定、课征）；与 tax 同源
column3: a piece of work that has to be done
column5: Each child was given a simple task.|The task took longer than expected.
column6: a piece of work assigned and expected to be finished – 派下来、须做完的一份活
column7: 任务：交下来要完成的那件事|活儿：具体动手做的那一份|差事：受派去办的事，多带受命的意味

column2: 中古英语 tasten ← 古法语 taster（尝、触）← 通俗拉丁语 *tastare ← 拉丁语 taxāre（触碰）← tangere（触）
column3: the sensation a food or drink gives in the mouth
column5: The soup has a smoky taste.|She has good taste in music.
column6: what the tongue reports about a thing – 舌头对一件东西给出的判断
column7: 味道：入口后舌头感到的那种性质|品味：把这种辨别力用到审美上|尝：把东西放进口中试其味这个动作

column2: 中古英语 taxe ← 中古法语 taxe ← 中世纪拉丁语 taxa ← 拉丁语 taxō（估定、课征）；取代了古英语 gafol
column3: money that people must pay to the government
column5: Income tax rose by two percent.|They tax imported cars heavily.
column6: a sum the state takes as a set share – 官府按定额抽走的那一份钱
column7: 税：这种强制征收的款项|税款：具体缴出的那笔钱|征税：官府抽取这笔钱这个动作

column2: 截自 taximeter cab（装计程表的出租马车）；taximeter ← 法语 taximètre ← 德语 Taxameter，由中世纪拉丁语 taxa（费额）造出
column3: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere
column5: We took a taxi from the station.|The plane taxied to the far end of the runway.
column6: a car hired by the trip, with the fare counted as you go – 按趟雇的车，路上边走边计费
column7: 出租车：可雇用载客的那种车|滑行：飞机在地面慢慢挪动，像出租车在场内绕，故借此词

column2: 1655 年前后始见于英语，借自荷兰语 thee ← 闽南语「茶」(tê)，荷兰东印度公司自厦门贩茶，故取此音
column3: a hot drink made by pouring boiling water on dried leaves
column5: She poured me a cup of tea.|Green tea is grown on these hills.
column6: a drink made by steeping dried leaves in hot water – 干叶在热水里泡出来的饮品
column7: 茶：这种饮品的通称|茶叶：泡它所用的干叶|茶水：泡好后杯中的那份液体

column2: 中古英语 techen ← 古英语 tǣċan（指示、教导）← 原始日耳曼语 *taikijaną（指示）← 原始印欧语 *deyḱ-（指出）
column3: to help someone learn something by explaining or showing it
column5: She teaches history at the local school.|He taught me how to sharpen a knife.
column6: showing someone how, until they can do it themselves – 把怎么做指给人看，直到他自己会
column7: 教：把知识或本事传给人|教授：在学校里成课地讲|使懂得：经历或事实让人明白了某个道理

column2: 中古英语 techere，即 teach ＋ 施事后缀 -er；teach 一支 ← 古英语 tǣċan（指示、教导）
column3: a person whose job is to help others learn
column5: Our maths teacher explained it twice.|She trained as a primary teacher.
column6: the one whose work is showing others how – 以指点他人为业的那个人
column7: 老师：日常称呼，泛指教人的人|教员：偏书面，指以教学为职务的人

column2: 中古英语 tem ← 古英语 tēam（一组挽畜、子嗣）← 原始日耳曼语 *taumaz（牵引之物）← 原始印欧语 *dewk-（牵、拉）
column3: a group of people who work or play together
column5: Our team won the final by one goal.|She leads a team of six engineers.
column6: several pulling together as one – 几个一起使力，算作一个
column7: 队：比赛或作业中的那一组人|团队：偏重共事协作的那批人|小组：人数少、任务专的那一组

column2: 中古英语 teren ← 古英语 teran（撕、裂）← 原始日耳曼语 *teraną（撕开）← 原始印欧语 *der-（撕裂）
column3: to pull something apart so that it comes into pieces
column5: He tore the letter into small pieces.|There is a tear in the sleeve.
column6: pulling until the material gives way and parts – 一直拉，直到那层料让开、分成两边
column7: 扯破：用力拉使之破开|撕裂：拉开后分成两半这个结果|眼泪：另一支同形异源的词，读音也不同

column2: 中古英语 tesen ← 古英语 tǣsan（梳理、撕开羊毛）← 原始西日耳曼语 *taisijan（分开、撕扯）
column3: to make fun of someone in a playful or annoying way
column5: His brothers teased him about his new haircut.|Stop teasing the cat with that string.
column6: picking at someone lightly, again and again – 一下一下地撩，不重但不停
column7: 逗弄：轻撩对方取乐|戏弄：撩得对方难受些|取笑：拿对方的短处说笑

column2: 由 tedium ＋ -ous 构成 ← 古法语 tedieus ← 晚期拉丁语 taediosus ← 拉丁语 taedium（厌倦）
column3: boring and going on for too long
column5: The meeting was long and tedious.|Copying the list by hand is tedious work.
column6: dragging on so long that attention wears out – 拖得太久，人的注意力被耗光
column7: 枯燥的：内容无味，提不起兴趣|冗长乏味的：既长又无味，两头都占

column2: 由 teenage ＋ -er 构成；teenage 出自 teen（十几岁，源自 -teen 后缀）＋ age（年岁）
column3: a person between thirteen and nineteen years old
column5: The film appeals mainly to teenagers.|As a teenager he worked weekends.
column6: someone in the years whose numbers end in -teen – 岁数带 -teen 那几年里的人
column7: 青少年：处在这个年龄段的人|十几岁的人：照岁数直说，范围更明确

column2: 由 tele-（远）＋ -gram（所写之物）构成，两支均出希腊语（tele 远、gramma 所写）
column3: a message sent by telegraph and delivered in writing
column5: He sent a telegram announcing his arrival.|The telegram arrived two days late.
column6: a short message sent along a wire and written out at the far end – 顺线送出的短消息，到那头再写成文字
column7: 电报：这种通信方式及其消息|电报稿：写下来交到收件人手里的那张

column2: 由 tele-（远）＋ -scope（看的器具）构成 ← 拉丁语 telescopium ← 希腊语 teleskopos（看得远的）；1611 年 Giovanni Demisiani 为伽利略的仪器所造
column3: an instrument that makes distant things look nearer
column5: He watched Saturn through a telescope.|The telescope needs refocusing after each move.
column6: a tube of lenses that brings the far near – 装着透镜的筒，把远处拉到眼前

column2: 中古英语 tellen（数、述）← 古英语 tellan（计数、讲述）← 原始日耳曼语 *taljaną（数、列举）← 原始印欧语 *del-（数、算）；与 tale 同支
column3: to give information to someone by speaking
column5: Tell me what happened last night.|I cannot tell the twins apart.
column6: putting what you know into the other person's hands – 把自己知道的交到对方手上
column7: 讲述：把事情成段说出来|告知：把某个消息通知对方|分辨：能把两者数清、说出区别，本义「数」留在这一层

column2: 中古英语 temple ← 古英语 templ，借自拉丁语 templum（圣所、划出的观兆之地）；取代了古英语本土词 ealh
column3: a building used for religious worship
column5: They visited a temple on the hillside.|He rubbed his temples wearily.
column6: a building marked off as sacred ground – 划出来当作圣地的那座建筑
column7: 寺庙：供奉神佛的那种建筑|神殿：古时供奉神明的殿宇|太阳穴：另一支同形异源的词，指眼角后侧那一处

column2: 借自意大利语 tempo（时间、速度）← 拉丁语 tempus（时间）
column3: the speed at which a piece of music is played
column5: The conductor picked up the tempo.|Life moves at a slower tempo here.
column6: how fast the beats follow one another – 拍子一个接一个来得多快
column7: 节奏：拍子的快慢与轻重|快慢：把这层用到做事的速度上

column2: 中古英语 tennys ← 古法语 tenez（接住吧，tenir「握、接」的复数命令式），发球时的呼语沿用成球名
column3: a game in which two or four players hit a ball over a net with rackets
column5: They play tennis every Sunday.|She won the tennis final in straight sets.
column6: a game of hitting a ball back over a net until one side misses – 隔网互击，直到一方接不住

column2: 借自中世纪拉丁语 tentativus（试探性的）← 拉丁语 tentō（尝试、试探）的过去分词 tentatus
column3: not certain or final, done as a first try
column5: They reached a tentative agreement.|He gave a tentative answer.
column6: put forward as a first try, ready to be changed – 先摆出来试试，随时可改
column7: 试探性的：先探一探，看反应再定|暂定的：暫且这么定下，尚未作准

column2: 中古英语 terme ← 古法语 terme ← 拉丁语 terminus（界、限、期）← 原始印欧语 *térmn̥（桩、界）
column3: a fixed period of time, or a word with a specific meaning
column5: He served a four-year term.|Define your terms before you argue.
column6: a boundary marked out, whether in time or in meaning – 划出来的一道界，可以是时间上的也可以是意义上的
column7: 期间：起止划定的那一段时间|术语：意义被划定的那个词|条款：合约里划定权责的那一条

column2: 借自晚期拉丁语 terminalis（与界、末端有关的）← 拉丁语 terminus（界、限、末端）
column3: the building or point at the end of a route, or a screen and keyboard for a computer
column5: We waited at the airport terminal.|Log in at any terminal in the room.
column6: the point where a line or route comes to its end – 一条线路走到尽头的那一处
column7: 终点站：路线最后那一站及其站房|末端：任何事物的最后一头|终端：接在系统末端、供人操作的那台设备

column2: 中古英语 terminaten ← 拉丁语 terminatus，是 terminō（划界、结束）的完成被动分词 ← terminus（界、限）
column3: to bring something to an end
column5: They terminated the contract in June.|The line terminates at the next station.
column6: drawing a boundary that nothing continues past – 划下一道界，过了这道就不再继续
column7: 终止：使正在进行的中断而不再续|结束：到此为止，自然收尾

column2: 中古英语 territorie ← 拉丁语 territorium（属城之地）← terra（土地）
column3: an area of land under the control of a country or person
column5: The treaty gave them the disputed territory.|Each salesman covers his own territory.
column6: a stretch of ground that one side holds and answers for – 由某一方掌管、也由它负责的那片地
column7: 领土：国家主权所及的疆域|地域：泛指划出来的一片地方|势力范围：某方实际能支配的那一片

column2: 由 text（正文）＋ book（书）复合而成；text 一支 ← 古法语 texte ← 拉丁语 textus（编织成的、文本）
column3: a book used for studying a subject at school or university
column5: Open your textbooks to page forty.|It was a textbook example of overreach.
column6: the book a course is taught from – 一门课照着教的那本书
column7: 教科书：课程指定的那本书|典型的：像书上写的标准例子那样，故有此引申

column2: 中古英语 thank（感激、谢意）← 古英语 þanc（谢意、心念）← 原始日耳曼语 *þankaz（谢意、思念）← 原始印欧语 *teng-（感知、想）
column3: to tell someone you are grateful for what they did
column5: I thanked her for the lift home.|He left without a word of thanks.
column6: putting one's sense of being helped into words – 把「受了人好处」这份心意说出来
column7: 感谢：心里存着受助之情并表达出来|致谢：把这份心意正式表达一次

column2: 中古英语 theater ← 古法语 theatre ← 拉丁语 theatrum ← 希腊语 theatron（观看之处）← theaomai（看、观）
column3: a building where plays are performed, or the art of drama
column5: The theater seats eight hundred.|She has worked in theater all her life.
column6: a place built so that many can watch one thing – 造出来让许多人看同一处的地方
column7: 剧院：演出戏剧的那座建筑|戏剧：这门以演出为形式的艺术|手术室：四周有观摩席的手术间，旧时如剧场，故沿此名

column2: 中古英语 theft ← 古英语 þīefþ ← 原始日耳曼语 *þiubiþō（偷窃）← *þiubijaną（偷）；即 thieve ＋ 抽象名词后缀 -th
column3: the crime of taking something that belongs to another
column5: He was charged with theft.|Bicycle theft has risen sharply.
column6: the taking of another's property as an offence – 把别人的东西取走，作为一项罪名
column7: 偷窃：这种行为本身|盗窃案：作为案件来说的那一起

column2: 中古英语 theires，14 世纪起见于记载，即 their ＋ -s，仿 his 的构式而成
column3: the one or ones belonging to them
column4: 他们的东西/属于他们的
column5: That car is theirs, not ours.|Our seats are here; theirs are at the back.
column6: the thing that belongs to those people – 属于那几个人的那一份
column7: 他们的东西：指归他们所有之物|属于他们的：说明归属，不点明是什么

column2: 中古英语 teme ← 古法语 teme ← 拉丁语 thema ← 希腊语 thema（所置之物、命题）← tithemi（放、置）
column3: the main subject that runs through a work or discussion
column5: Love is the central theme of the play.|Each room follows a different theme.
column6: the one idea laid down that everything else circles – 定下的那一个意思，其余都围着它转
column7: 主题：贯穿全篇的那个中心意思|题目：所议所写的那个题|主旋律：乐曲里反复出现、统起全曲的那段调子

column2: 由 them ＋ -selves 构成；self 一支 ← 古英语 self（自身）← 原始日耳曼语 *selbaz
column3: used to refer back to the people already mentioned as the subject
column5: The children dressed themselves this morning.|They built the shed themselves.
column6: pointing back at the same people just named – 回指刚说过的那几个人
column7: 他们自己：动作落回施动者本身|亲自：强调是他们本人做的，无人代劳
